summary: Heartland Express filed an 8-K disclosing a board-declared regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.02 per share, payable October 7, 2026 to holders of record September 25, 2026; the company estimates roughly $1.5 million total on approximately 77 million shares. This marks the 93rd consecutive quarterly dividend, bringing cumulative cash dividends paid to $566.1 million, including four prior special dividends since the 2003 program launch. No advisor or board recommendation is cited; mechanics are a standard record-date/payment-date schedule with no overhang or regulatory clock. Watch for continuation amid freight-cycle cash-flow pressure.
